segments.title: Siri can send your text LATER
segments.say: Siri can now schedule your iMessages to send later, in the iOS twenty seven point three beta.

segments.title: Just ask Siri
segments.say: Ask Siri to schedule a message, and it goes out later.

segments.title: Siri can also…
segments.say: In the same beta, Siri can also edit or unsend texts, make and save a playlist, and add a Journal entry.

segments.title: Beta only, for now
segments.say: It's beta only for now. 9to5Mac says the public release comes later this year. Not tested by us.

segments.sub: to the friend who texts you at 2am
segments.say: Send this to the friend who always texts you at two a.m.
